count_per_sector.gml: var lo = 99; var hi = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 40; g++) { global.run.sector = 1 + (g mod 3); map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; var c = 0; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) if (nd[i].hazard != "") c += 1; lo = min(lo, c); hi = max(hi, c); } return lo * 100 + hi;

endpoints_clear.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 40; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) { if ((nd[i].kind == "start" || nd[i].kind == "exit") && nd[i].hazard != "") return false; } } return true;

every_region_bites_something.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var mp = global.run.map; for (var q = 0; q < array_length(mp.hazards); q++) { var reg = mp.hazards[q]; var h = hazard(reg.id); var bites = false; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(mp.nodes); i++) { if (mp.nodes[i].hazard != reg.id) continue; if (!hazard_region_contains(reg, mp.nodes[i].px, mp.nodes[i].py)) continue; if (!h.combat || mp.nodes[i].kind == "fight") bites = true; } if (!bites) return false; } } return true;

never_covers_everything.gml: var worst = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; var c = 0; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) if (nd[i].hazard != "") c += 1; worst = max(worst, c / array_length(nd)); } return round(worst * 100);

shading_matches_what_bites.gml: for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var mp = global.run.map; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(mp.nodes); i++) { var n = mp.nodes[i]; var inside = ""; for (var q = 0; q < array_length(mp.hazards); q++) { if (hazard_region_contains(mp.hazards[q], n.px, n.py)) inside = mp.hazards[q].id; } if (inside != n.hazard) return false; } } return true;

regions_per_sector.gml: var lo = 99; var hi = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { global.run.sector = 1 + (g mod 3); map_generate(); var c = array_length(global.run.map.hazards); lo = min(lo, c); hi = max(hi, c); } return lo * 100 + hi;

regions_cover_more_than_one_stop.gml: var multi = 0; var tot = 0; for (var g = 0; g < 60; g++) { map_generate(); var mp = global.run.map; for (var q = 0; q < array_length(mp.hazards); q++) { var c = 0; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(mp.nodes); i++) if (hazard_region_contains(mp.hazards[q], mp.nodes[i].px, mp.nodes[i].py)) c += 1; tot += 1; if (c > 1) multi += 1; } } if (tot == 0) return -1; return round(multi / tot * 100);

every_kind_appears.gml: var seen = {}; for (var g = 0; g < 120; g++) { map_generate(); var nd = global.run.map.nodes; for (var i = 0; i < array_length(nd); i++) if (nd[i].hazard != "") variable_struct_set(seen, nd[i].hazard, true); } return array_length(variable_struct_get_names(seen));

rough_costs_two.gml: run_new(); map_generate(); var r = global.run; var here = map_node(r.node); var dest = -1; for (var k = 0; k < array_length(here.links); k++) { var c = here.links[k]; if (!map_node_lost(c) && map_node(c).kind != "exit") { dest = c; break; } } if (dest < 0) return -1; map_node(dest).hazard = "rough"; r.fuel = 10; map_travel(dest); return 10 - r.fuel;

clear_costs_one.gml: run_new(); map_generate(); var r = global.run; var here = map_node(r.node); var dest = -1; for (var k = 0; k < array_length(here.links); k++) { var c = here.links[k]; if (!map_node_lost(c) && map_node(c).kind != "exit") { dest = c; break; } } if (dest < 0) return -1; map_node(dest).hazard = ""; r.fuel = 10; map_travel(dest); return 10 - r.fuel;

acid_rain_lands.gml: random_set_seed(4242); run_new(); map_generate(); var r = global.run; r.map.nodes[r.node].hazard = "acidrain"; global.combat_ctx = { faction: "robots", elite: false, boss: false, diff: 1.0 }; combat_init(); var seen = 0; for (var i = 0; i < 600 && global.cb.over == ""; i++) { combat_update(1/60); var c = global.cb.player; for (var f = 0; f < array_length(c.facs); f++) if (c.facs[f].st.acid > 0) { seen = 1; break; } if (seen) break; } return seen;

clear_country_has_no_acid.gml: random_set_seed(4242); run_new(); map_generate(); var r = global.run; r.map.nodes[r.node].hazard = ""; global.combat_ctx = { faction: "robots", elite: false, boss: false, diff: 1.0 }; combat_init(); var seen = 0; for (var i = 0; i < 600 && global.cb.over == ""; i++) { combat_update(1/60); var c = global.cb.player; for (var f = 0; f < array_length(c.facs); f++) if (c.facs[f].st.acid > 0) { seen = 1; break; } if (seen) break; } return seen;

climb_escape_pct_of_clear.gml: var out = [0, 0]; var hz = ["", "climb"]; for (var k = 0; k < 2; k++) { random_set_seed(77); run_new(); map_generate(); global.run.map.nodes[global.run.node].hazard = hz[k]; global.combat_ctx = { faction: "robots", elite: false, boss: false, diff: 1.0 }; combat_init(); global.cb.player.harpoon = 0; for (var i = 0; i < 120; i++) { global.cb.player.harpoon = 0; combat_update(1/60); } out[k] = global.cb.player.escape; } if (out[0] <= 0) return -1; return round(out[1] / out[0] * 100);

static_repair_pct_of_clear.gml: var out = [0, 0]; var hz = ["", "interference"]; for (var k = 0; k < 2; k++) { random_set_seed(88); run_new(); map_generate(); global.run.map.nodes[global.run.node].hazard = hz[k]; global.combat_ctx = { faction: "robots", elite: false, boss: false, diff: 1.0 }; combat_init(); var cb = global.cb; var f = cb.player.facs[0]; f.hp = 1; f.repair_t = 0; if (array_length(cb.drones) == 0) return -1; cb.drones[0].fac = 0; for (var i = 0; i < 180; i++) combat_update(1/60); var g = cb.player.facs[0]; if (g.hp >= g.hp_max) return -2; out[k] = (g.hp - 1) * DRONE_REPAIR_TIME + g.repair_t; } if (out[0] <= 0) return -1; return round(out[1] / out[0] * 100);

dust_bonus_is_wired.gml: run_new(); map_generate(); global.run.map.nodes[global.run.node].hazard = "duststorm"; global.combat_ctx = { faction: "robots", elite: false, boss: false, diff: 1.0 }; combat_init(); return round(global.cb.hz.evade_bonus * 100);

dust_costs_both_sides_damage.gml: var out = [0, 0]; var hz = ["", "duststorm"]; for (var k = 0; k < 2; k++) { random_set_seed(1234); var tot = 0; var ended = 0; for (var t = 0; t < 30; t++) { run_new(); map_generate(); global.run.map.nodes[global.run.node].hazard = hz[k]; global.combat_ctx = { faction: "bandits", elite: false, boss: false, diff: 1.0 }; combat_init(); var cb = global.cb; var h0 = 0; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(cb.enemies); e++) for (var f = 0; f < array_length(cb.enemies[e].facs); f++) h0 += cb.enemies[e].facs[f].hp; for (var i = 0; i < 480; i++) combat_update(1/60); if (cb.over != "") ended += 1; var h1 = 0; for (var e = 0; e < array_length(cb.enemies); e++) for (var f = 0; f < array_length(cb.enemies[e].facs); f++) h1 += max(0, cb.enemies[e].facs[f].hp); tot += (h0 - h1); } if (ended > 0) return -3; out[k] = tot; } if (out[0] <= 0) return -1; return round(out[1] / out[0] * 100);
